subject: government

items.question: Document-Based Question — Using at least THREE documents from the Unit 1 primary-source set (Locke's Second Treatise, the Declaration of Independence, Federalist No. 10, Federalist No. 51, Brutus No. 1, the Preamble, and the Bill of Rights), construct an argument: Did the Founders build a government that trusts the people, or one that guards against them? Support your claim with evidence from the documents and explain how the documents corroborate or complicate one another (synthesis).
items.question_es: Pregunta basada en documentos — Usando al menos TRES documentos del conjunto de la Unidad 1, argumenta: ¿Los Fundadores construyeron un gobierno que confía en el pueblo o que se protege de él?
items.rubric: Tennessee EOC-style DBQ rubric: thesis, use of ≥3 documents, sourcing, outside evidence, synthesis.

remediation.next_step: Re-anchor on the primary source, re-teach the 3 vocabulary terms (EN/ES), then re-attempt a parallel item.
